name: ai-question-extension
description: MVP: extensão Chrome (MV3) que detecta questões de múltipla escolha e mostra a alternativa escolhida por um motor de IA

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,extension -c blue,green "npm run server" "npm run dev -w extension"
scripts.package:extension: npm run build:extension && powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path extension\dist\* -DestinationPath ai-question-assistant.zip -Force"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w extension && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w extension && npm run test -w server
